title: **User time zone is unknown** — the SDK protocol does not carry a user time zone, so time context reports `Browser time zone for this request: unavailable.` The process or container time zone may differ from the user's. The `time-context.ti...

attrs.text: **User time zone is unknown** — the SDK protocol does not carry a user time zone, so time context reports `Browser time zone for this request: unavailable.` The process or container time zone may differ from the user's. The `time-context.timeZone` setting only controls fallback timestamp formatting; it does not establish the user's time zone. Automatic detection and SDK time-zone input are deferred.

title: **TLS is opt-in and unmanaged** — the listener serves HTTPS only when `--tls-cert` and `--tls-key` name a full chain and its unencrypted key; DSH never obtains, renews, or watches certificates, and a changed file needs a listener reload or ...

attrs.text: **TLS is opt-in and unmanaged** — the listener serves HTTPS only when `--tls-cert` and `--tls-key` name a full chain and its unencrypted key; DSH never obtains, renews, or watches certificates, and a changed file needs a listener reload or a process restart. The browser must trust that certificate, its names must cover the authority you open, and the certificate is independent of `--public-url`.
